factors.information_edge: Useful when avoiding bad trades matters more than adding extra entries.
factors.non_edge_warning: Tradeability context is usually a gating layer, not a directional edge by itself.
misuse_patterns: Treating execution filters as directional alpha.
Ignoring slippage and adverse selection in fast markets.
